description: Timeout 终态幂等性输入 — 迁移到 B54 时复用 B44 链路

timeoutFinalizationExactlyOnce.description: Timeout 终态只被写入一次
timeoutFinalizationExactlyOnce.guarantee: 同一 Invocation ID 不会产生两次 timed_out finalization

lateCallbackIgnored.description: 超时后的 Late Provider Callback 被忽略而不触发新终态
lateCallbackIgnored.rule: Late result guard in B43 late_result_guard.json

attemptRelation.description: Retry 场景下每次尝试的 Timeout 终态独立但受整体 Deadline 约束
attemptRelation.rule: Per-attempt Timeout → attempt timed_out; Overall Deadline → invocation timed_out

overallInvocationRelation.description: 整体 Invocation Timeout 为唯一终态權威
overallInvocationRelation.rule: Once invocation timed_out committed, no late result from any attempt can change

constraints.noNewAuthority: 幂等保证复用 B43 terminal state guard，不引入新的 Idempotency Manager
